svg.text: Reads: M beats (A) and K beats (B), address = base + 4·beat. Writes: M·N beats, address = dest_c + 16·m + 4·j.

text.font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Unused bytes are masked to 0 inside the buffers, so A/B need no padding in SRAM.
